review.boundary_review: The strip at x≈0-360 is the edge of fol. 222b. Its fragments ('for', '232/13', and the ← arrows at the c. 79-80, c. 77 and c. 80(2) lines) belong to 222b's margin notes and are correctly excluded, with possible attachments kept uncertain. Fol. 223b appears blank apart from its folio label and is not a target.

region_review.bottom: The Rāmāyaṇa group runs through to the last line, c. 80 (2), and is represented with its corrections.
region_review.left_margin: Contains the insert note, the faint pencil 'See Adhyātma...', ticks, an isolated asterisk and ink specks. Facing-page fragments are excluded.
region_review.right_margin: Contains 'D.' below the e. 125 line and corrected figures for c. 343, c. 79-80 and c. 77. No separate marginal notes were found.
region_review.interlinear: Captured: 'bhadrāya', 'Rāmacandrāya', the addition above 'mūrtaye' (reading revised as uncertain), 'n.d.:19:9: D.', 'I by Rāmavarman.', '(or Maheśa Yati)', 'pupil', '15/17' and the superscript on c. 77.
